subject: Civil Engineering
title: Irregularity in Plan and Elevation
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Irregularity in Plan and Elevation.

hook.text: Symmetric buildings ride earthquakes like a boat on waves. Irregular ones twist and fail.

buildup.text: Plan irregularity — L-shapes, T-shapes — causes torsion. One wing twists against another.

discovery.text: Vertical irregularity — setbacks, soft stories — concentrates damage at the transition.

twist.text: Seismic joints separate irregular buildings into regular blocks — each sways independently.

climax.text: Codes penalize irregular buildings with higher design forces — a built-in safety margin.

punchline.text: Simple, symmetric shapes survive earthquakes best. Complexity invites failure.

quiz.question: What problem does plan irregularity cause during an earthquake?
options: The building sinks unevenly into the soil
Asymmetric stiffness causes the building to twist (torsion) during shaking
Windows on one side break while the other side remains intact
